edge_explainer: The queue asked 'RIPPING +48%, quality-at-price question now'. Answer: the rip is real and the quality is not. Versigent is the ELECTRICAL DISTRIBUTION SYSTEMS segment (8-K 04-01 Item 2.01) - the commodity wiring-harness half of the Aptiv split; Aptiv retained Advanced Safety & User Experience and Engineered Components. $2.1B of debt ($800M 6.125% 2031 + $800M 6.375% 2034 + $500M TLA fully drawn) was raised to pay a dividend TO APTIV, taking book equity NEGATIVE $48M from +$1,657M. COURT-INTERNAL CORRECTION: my first read of Q1 op income $74M vs $123M as 'severe margin compression' was WRONG - ex-restructuring ($46M vs $16M) and separation costs ($26M vs $5M), adjusted EBIT was roughly FLAT at $146M vs $144M, a ~50bp decline not 280bp. What survives: gross margin fell 130bp (12.3%->11.0%) on RISING volume with SG&A cut to offset (a one-time lever); capex $66M EXCEEDS D&A $61M; Q1 FCF was NEGATIVE ~$30M; restructuring is chronic here, not exceptional. Tape: rip ended 2026-06-04 at $50.17 and the last six weeks are a $39-44 consolidation - the 'RIPPING' framing is two months stale. Path check: +59.6% off a ~4-month-old low = late.
